title: Derive a value with a calc rule
description: Register a metric, author a calc rule that writes each component's slowest TCP connect time to it, preview the values it would write, save it, and read what it computed on each component.

steps.caption: A calc rule writes a metric or property of its own. First register the metric it will write.
Name it. The rule will write each component's slowest connect time here.
Create it. A metric no collection writes is one a calc rule may write.
Calc rules derive a value from others, on each component or each system.
Each input has a short name the reduce uses.
It reads TCP connect time, one value for each endpoint on a component.
Fold them with max, the slowest endpoint wins.
Write the result to the new metric.
Preview computes the draft on each component now, writing nothing.
The value it would write on each component, beside what that component holds now.
Save it. The rule computes again whenever an input changes.
Its blade shows the value it last computed on each component.
